title: Word wrap
hints: Loop over `strings.Fields(text)` and write into one `strings.Builder`. Keep an `int` with the rune length of the line you are currently filling.

For each word (length `n := utf8.RuneCountInString(word)`): if the current line is empty, just write the word; else if `lineLen+1+n <= width`, write a space and the word; otherwise write `"\n"` and start a new line with the word.

Sketch:
```go
lineLen := 0
for _, w := range strings.Fields(text) {
	n := utf8.RuneCountInString(w)
	switch {
	case lineLen == 0:
	case lineLen+1+n <= width:
		b.WriteByte(' ')
		lineLen++
	default:
		b.WriteByte('\n')
		lineLen = 0
	}
	b.WriteString(w)
	lineLen += n
}
```
